properties.name: Bakerloo Line Extension
properties.timeline: Proposed extension from Elephant & Castle through Old Kent Road and New Cross Gate to Lewisham.
properties.description: Transport for London is developing plans to extend the Bakerloo line into southeast London, with a core proposal to Lewisham and a possible future extension beyond it.
milestones: Delivery remains subject to funding and approvals
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Waterloo–Lewisham corridor; the future alignment and station geometry remain subject to funding and approvals.

properties.name: Grand Paris Express Line 15 South
properties.timeline: Pont de Sèvres to Noisy–Champs; passenger service planned for 2027.
properties.description: The first major southern section of the Grand Paris Express is a fully automated metro ring connecting the southern suburbs of Paris from Pont de Sèvres to Noisy–Champs.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate corridor based on the official station sequence; authoritative station points are not included in this first batch.

properties.name: Dublin MetroLink
properties.agency: Transport Infrastructure Ireland / National Transport Authority
properties.timeline: Approximately 19 km from Estuary and Swords through Dublin Airport and the city centre to Charlemont, with 16 stations.
properties.description: MetroLink is a planned automated metro connecting Swords, Dublin Airport, north Dublin, the city centre, and Charlemont. Its Railway Order became operative in January 2026 and major construction packages are entering procurement.
milestones: Railway Order became operative in January 2026
Airport and civil-works packages entering procurement
properties.geometry_note: Approximate route based on the official preferred alignment; station points are not included in this first batch.

properties.name: Oslo Fornebu Line
properties.timeline: Approximately 7.7 km from Majorstuen to Fornebu with six new underground stations; opening planned for 2029.
properties.description: The Fornebu Line is a new Oslo metro extension connecting Majorstuen with the growing Fornebu area through Skøyen, Vækerø, Lysaker, Fornebuporten, and Flytårnet.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Majorstuen–Fornebu corridor; station points are not included in this first batch.

properties.name: Madrid Metro Line 11 Extension
properties.agency: Comunidad de Madrid / Metro de Madrid
properties.timeline: Plaza Elíptica to Conde de Casal; 6.6 km and five stations, with works scheduled to finish in 2027.
properties.description: The first major phase of Madrid’s Line 11 expansion extends the metro across the south of the city, linking Plaza Elíptica with Palos de la Frontera, Atocha, and Conde de Casal.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Plaza Elíptica–Conde de Casal corridor; station points are not included in this batch.

properties.name: Barcelona Diagonal Tram Connection
properties.agency: Ajuntament de Barcelona / Autoritat del Transport Metropolità
properties.timeline: Francesc Macià to Glòries via Avinguda Diagonal; the second-phase reurbanization project is complete and connection work continues through approvals.
properties.description: The planned Diagonal connection will join Barcelona’s Trambaix and Trambesòs networks, creating a unified tram corridor between Francesc Macià and Glòries.
milestones: Final tram connection remains in project development
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Francesc Macià–Glòries corridor; the final construction alignment and station points are not included in this batch.

properties.name: Siemensbahn Reactivation
properties.timeline: Reactivation of the 4.5 km Jungfernheide–Gartenfeld S-Bahn corridor, with realization planned between 2026 and 2029.
properties.description: Deutsche Bahn is reactivating Berlin’s disused Siemensbahn to reconnect Siemensstadt and Gartenfeld with the S-Bahn ring and the wider rail network.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Jungfernheide–Gartenfeld corridor; the reactivated station and track geometry is represented schematically.

properties.name: Copenhagen M5 Metro
properties.timeline: Nine-station metro planned in two phases; the first phase is planned to open in 2036 and the second in 2045.
properties.description: M5 is Copenhagen’s planned new metro line, connecting København H and Amager with future development areas in Østhavnen, including Refshaleøen and Lynetteholm.
milestones: First phase planned to open in 2036
properties.geometry_note: Approximate M5 corridor based on the current station sequence; phase-two alignment and station forms remain subject to later decisions.

properties.name: Stockholm Blue Line to Nacka and Söderort
properties.agency: Region Stockholm / Förvaltning för utbyggd tunnelbana
properties.timeline: Extension from Kungsträdgården through Sofia, with branches to Nacka and Söderort; traffic start planned for 2030.
properties.description: Stockholm’s Blue Line expansion adds seven stations and two branches, extending metro service east to Nacka and south through Gullmarsplan and Sockenplan.
milestones: Nacka and Söderort branches under construction
properties.geometry_note: Approximate branched corridor based on the official station sequence; station points are not included in this batch.

properties.name: Rome Metro Line C Extension
properties.timeline: Construction continues through the historic centre toward Venezia, with the northwest T2 extension planned toward Clodio–Mazzini and Farnesina.
properties.description: Rome’s Line C program is advancing through the historic centre toward Piazza Venezia and the northwest, where the future extension toward Clodio–Mazzini and Farnesina is being developed.
milestones: Construction continues through the historic centre
Clodio–Mazzini and Farnesina extensions in development
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Colosseo–Venezia–Clodio/Farnesina corridor; the future alignment and station geometry remain subject to project development.

properties.name: Amsterdam–Schiphol–Hoofddorp Transit Connection
properties.agency: Municipality of Amsterdam / national MIRT study partners
properties.timeline: Amsterdam Zuid through Schiphol to Hoofddorp; a preferred alternative is planned to be selected in 2026.
properties.description: A national MIRT study is comparing better public-transit connections between Amsterdam Zuid, Schiphol, and Hoofddorp, including possible extensions of the Noord/Zuidlijn.
milestones: Solutions include metro and other transit alternatives
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Amsterdam Zuid–Schiphol–Hoofddorp study corridor; the mode and final alignment have not been selected.

properties.name: Brussels Metro Line 3
properties.timeline: Albert to Bordet, combining conversion of the existing premetro with a new north–south tunnel and eight new stations.
properties.description: Brussels Metro Line 3 will convert the existing north–south premetro and extend it from Brussels-South toward Bordet, including a new tunnel and the Toots Thielemans station.
milestones: New north–south tunnel planned and under construction
Eight new stations included in the northern extension
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Albert–Bordet corridor; the line combines existing premetro infrastructure with a new tunnel and station works.

properties.name: Helsinki Crown Bridges Tramway
properties.timeline: Approximately 8 km from Hakaniemi through Kalasatama and Korkeasaari to Laajasalo; service preparation is underway for a planned 2027 opening.
properties.description: The Crown Bridges tramway will connect Helsinki city centre with Laajasalo through the new Kruunuvuorensilta bridge, Korkeasaari, and Kalasatama.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Hakaniemi–Kalasatama–Korkeasaari–Laajasalo corridor; bridge and station geometry is represented schematically.

properties.name: Tampere Tramway Pirkkala–Linnainmaa
properties.timeline: Two construction branches extend from central Tampere to Pirkkala and Linnainmaa; track, stops, and street works are underway in 2026.
properties.description: The Pirkkala–Linnainmaa project expands Tampere’s tramway south to Pirkkala and east from the city centre toward Linnainmaa, with associated street and depot works.
milestones: Rails and stops being built in 2026
Pirkkala and Linnainmaa branches in delivery
properties.geometry_note: Approximate branched corridor from central Tampere; the route and stop geometry is schematic and not a survey dataset.

properties.name: Vienna U2xU5 Expansion
properties.timeline: The first stage extends U2 to Matzleinsdorfer Platz and builds U5 to Frankhplatz; U5 to Hernals is planned from 2028 and U2 to Wienerberg from 2030.
properties.description: Vienna’s U2xU5 program combines the southern U2 extension with the city’s new automated U5, creating new interchange points and extending rapid transit toward Hernals and Wienerberg in later stages.
milestones: First-stage tunnels and stations under construction
U5 Frankhplatz structural completion planned for 2026
Later U5 and U2 stages rescheduled for 2028 and 2030 starts
properties.geometry_note: Approximate branched U2/U5 corridor based on the current staged program; station and tunnel geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Prague Metro Line D
properties.timeline: Pankrác to Nové Dvory is being built in linked sections, with three additional stations in the Olbrachtova–Nové Dvory works and service expected in the second half of 2032.
properties.description: Metro Line D is Prague’s new southbound metro corridor. DPP began the next section from Olbrachtova to Nové Dvory in June 2026, including tunnels, Nádraží Krč, Nemocnice Krč, and Nové Dvory stations.
milestones: Olbrachtova–Nové Dvory construction began in June 2026
Five-station Pankrác–Nové Dvory service expected in 2032
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Pankrác–Nové Dvory–Písnice corridor; the route and station geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Porto Metro Rubi Line
properties.timeline: Casa da Música to Santo Ovídio via Campo Alegre, Arrábida, and Devesas, including a new metro-only bridge over the Douro.
properties.description: The Rubi Line is a new north–south Metro do Porto corridor connecting Porto and Vila Nova de Gaia with a dedicated Douro crossing and an interchange at Devesas railway station.
milestones: Casa da Música–Santo Ovídio corridor in delivery
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Casa da Música–Santo Ovídio corridor; the bridge, station, and approach geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Lisbon Red Line to Alcântara
properties.timeline: The 4.1 km São Sebastião–Alcântara extension adds four stations; the current official schedule targets service in 2030.
properties.description: Lisbon’s Red Line is planned to extend west from São Sebastião through Campolide, Campo de Ourique, and Infante Santo to Alcântara, where it will connect with the future LIOS corridor.
milestones: Financing structure awaits European Investment Bank approval
properties.geometry_note: Approximate São Sebastião–Alcântara corridor; the final construction and station geometry is represented schematically.

properties.name: Bucharest Metro Line M6
properties.timeline: The 1 Mai–Henri Coandă Airport metro connection is planned as a 14.2 km, 12-station corridor with construction and systems procurement continuing in 2026.
properties.description: Metro Line M6 will connect northern Bucharest with Băneasa and Henri Coandă International Airport, extending the metro network from 1 Mai through the airport corridor.
milestones: Tunnel-boring works reported on the airport corridor
Rolling stock and automation packages scheduled in 2026
properties.geometry_note: Approximate 1 Mai–Băneasa–Henri Coandă corridor; station and airport approach geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Sofia Metro Line 3 Northeast Extension
properties.timeline: The 3 km northeast extension beyond Hadzhi Dimitar opened to passengers on 14 August 2026 with three stations.
properties.description: Sofia Metro Line 3 now reaches the Levski neighbourhood through the new Stadion Georgi Asparuhov, Besarabia, and Gen. Vladimir Vazov stations.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Hadzhi Dimitar–Levski corridor; station locations and final track geometry are represented schematically.

properties.name: Belgrade Metro Line 1 Phase 1
properties.agency: Belgrade Metro and Train / City of Belgrade
properties.timeline: The first phase is preparing approximately 11 km of underground tunnelling, with tunnel-boring machines being transported for launch from Makiš and Karaburma.
properties.description: Belgrade’s first metro line has moved into tunnel-construction preparation, with two TBMs factory-tested and shipped toward launch sites at Makiš and Karaburma.
milestones: Tunnel launch sites prepared at Makiš and Karaburma
properties.geometry_note: Approximate first-line phase corridor and TBM launch segments; final alignment and station geometry are not represented authoritatively here.

properties.name: Sarajevo Ilidža–Hrasnica Tramway Extension
properties.timeline: The tramway extension from Ilidža to Hrasnica remains under construction, with work-related service changes recorded in 2026.
properties.description: Sarajevo is extending its tramway south from Ilidža toward Hrasnica, adding a new corridor beyond the existing network and improving access to the southern suburbs.
milestones: Temporary transit changes issued for works
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Ilidža–Hrasnica corridor; the extension’s final track and stop geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Warsaw M2 Western Extension to Karolin
properties.timeline: The final western section adds Lazurowa, Chrzanów, and Karolin over roughly 4 km; construction is active in 2026.
properties.description: The final western extension of Warsaw’s M2 continues beyond Bemowo to Lazurowa, Chrzanów, and Karolin, with a new technical and maintenance depot.
milestones: Karolin technical and maintenance depot included
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Bemowo–Lazurowa–Chrzanów–Karolin corridor; station and depot geometry is schematic, and adjacent intermodal works remain separately approved.

properties.name: Kraków KST IV Tram to Mistrzejowice
properties.agency: Zarząd Dróg Miasta Krakowa / MPK Kraków
properties.timeline: The approximately 4.5 km KST IV corridor from Lema and Meissnera to Mistrzejowice is in construction and completion works in 2026.
properties.description: Kraków’s KST IV project adds a fast tram connection from the Lema and Meissnera area through Młyńska and Dobrego Pasterza to Mistrzejowice.
milestones: Construction and testing works continued in 2026
Mistrzejowice connection in final delivery phase
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Lema–Meissnera–Mistrzejowice tram corridor; final track, stop, and roadway geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Athens Metro Line 4 Section A
properties.timeline: Alsos Veikou–Goudi; 12.8 km and 15 stations, with tunnel works and station construction active in 2026.
properties.description: Athens’ new Line 4 will connect Galatsi, Kypseli, Exarchia, the Academy, Kolonaki, Evangelismos, Ilisia, Zografou, and Goudi.
milestones: 12.8 km and 15 stations in Section A
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Alsos Veikou–Goudi corridor; station and tunnel geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Thessaloniki Metro Kalamaria Extension
properties.timeline: The 4.78 km underground extension with five stations began passenger service on 27 August 2026.
properties.description: The Kalamaria branch extends Thessaloniki Metro southeast from 25is Martiou through Nomarchia, Kalamaria, Aretsou, Nea Krini, and Mikra.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate 25is Martiou–Mikra corridor; station locations and final track geometry are schematic.

properties.name: Lisbon Violeta Light Metro
properties.agency: Metropolitano de Lisboa / Municipalities of Loures and Odivelas
properties.timeline: The 11.5 km, 17-station light metro between Hospital Beatriz Ângelo, Odivelas, and Loures has a completion target of 2029.
properties.description: The Violeta line is a planned light-metro connection for Loures and Odivelas. Its procurement is being reset after all 2024 bids exceeded the base budget.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Hospital Beatriz Ângelo–Odivelas–Loures corridor; final alignment and station geometry remain subject to procurement.

properties.name: Porto Metro Pink Line
properties.timeline: The circular/direct Boavista–Baixa corridor from Casa da Música to São Bento is under construction, with works continuing in 2026.
properties.description: The Pink Line links Casa da Música to São Bento, serving Galiza, Hospital Santo António, and central Porto through a new underground corridor.

Hospital Santo António station in final construction phase
Central Porto street and shaft works continuing
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Casa da Música–Galiza–São Bento corridor; the underground route and station geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Turin Metro Line 2
properties.timeline: The first functional lot from Rebaudengo to Porta Nuova is 7.7 km with 10 stations; works are planned to begin in autumn 2026 and service is targeted for 2032.
properties.description: Turin’s new Y-shaped Metro Line 2 will connect Rebaudengo, the city centre, Porta Nuova, and future southern and northern branches; the first lot is financed.
milestones: 7.7 km and 10 stations in first lot
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Rebaudengo–Porta Nuova first-lot corridor; the wider Y-shaped network and final station geometry remain subject to delivery stages.

properties.name: Zagreb Sarajevska Tramway Extension
properties.timeline: The 2.25 km new tram line from Avenija Dubrovnik toward Ranžirni kolodvor is near completion, with opening expected in autumn 2026.
properties.description: The Sarajevska corridor extends Zagreb’s tram network south through Zapruđe, Travno, Utrina, Dugave, and Jakuševec.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Avenija Dubrovnik–Sarajevska–Ranžirni kolodvor corridor; final track and stop geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Skopje Bus Rapid Transit
properties.timeline: The two-line BRT program includes dedicated corridors, a new fleet, and a depot; environmental assessment documents remain part of current preparation.
properties.description: Skopje’s planned BRT would create two high-capacity bus corridors operated by JSP Skopje, supported by a new depot and dedicated infrastructure.
milestones: Environmental and social assessment remains in preparation
properties.geometry_note: Approximate city BRT corridors; final route and stop geometry is not authoritative.

properties.name: Sofia Metro Line 3 Slatina Extension
properties.timeline: The 6 km, six-station extension from Shipka through Geo Milev and Slatina to Arena Sofia and Tsarigradsko Shose is targeted for completion in 2027.
properties.description: This eastern Line 3 extension serves Geo Milev, Slatina, Arena Sofia, Sofia Tech Park, and Tsarigradsko Shose.
milestones: Tunnel works and station construction active
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Shipka–Geo Milev–Slatina–Tsarigradsko Shose corridor; station and track geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Grand Paris Express Line 18
properties.timeline: The 35 km automatic metro from Orly Airport to Versailles–Chantiers is being delivered in phases: Massy–Christ de Saclay in 2026, Orly in 2027, and Versailles in 2030.
properties.description: Line 18 will connect Orly Airport, Massy, the Paris-Saclay research campus, Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines, and Versailles with 10 new stations.
milestones: Testing underway on the first section
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Orly–Massy–Saclay–Versailles corridor; the mixed tunnel and viaduct alignment is schematic.

properties.name: Grand Paris Express Line 16
properties.timeline: The 29 km line from Saint-Denis–Pleyel to Noisy–Champs will open in two stages: to Clichy–Montfermeil in 2027 and to Noisy–Champs in 2028.
properties.description: Line 16 is a new automated metro across northeastern Paris, serving La Courneuve, Le Bourget, Aulnay-sous-Bois, Sevran, Clichy-sous-Bois, Chelles, and Noisy–Champs.
milestones: Station and tunnel systems being installed
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Saint-Denis–Pleyel–Chelles–Noisy–Champs corridor; station and tunnel geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Hovedstadens Letbane (Ring 3)
properties.timeline: The 28 km Ring 3 light-rail line between Ishøj and Lundtofte opened across its full length on 22 August 2026 with 29 stations.
properties.description: Copenhagen’s new orbital light rail connects Ishøj, the western suburbs, Herlev Hospital, DTU, and Lundtofte with six S-train interchanges.
milestones: Full 28 km line now in passenger service
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Ishøj–Ring 3–Lundtofte corridor; station locations and local street alignment are schematic.

properties.name: Naples Metro Line 1 to Capodichino
properties.agency: Comune di Napoli / Metropolitana di Napoli
properties.timeline: The Centro Direzionale–Capodichino section, including the Poggioreale and Capodichino stations, remains in construction and completion works in the 2026–2028 program.
properties.description: Line 1 is extending east and north from the city centre through Centro Direzionale, Poggioreale, and Capodichino to reach Naples International Airport.
milestones: Poggioreale and Capodichino stations in delivery
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Centro Direzionale–Poggioreale–Capodichino corridor; underground alignment and station geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Munich U5 Extension to Pasing
properties.timeline: The 3.8 km western U5 extension from Laimer Platz to Pasing is being built with the new Am Knie and Pasing stations.
properties.description: Munich’s U5 is extending west to Pasing, adding a direct underground connection to the growing western district and its regional rail interchange.
milestones: Am Knie and Pasing stations included
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Laimer Platz–Am Knie–Pasing corridor; station and tunnel geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Gdańsk Południe–Wrzeszcz Tram
properties.timeline: The 3.6 km tram route from Piecki-Migowo to Wrzeszcz is scheduled to start in the third quarter of 2026 and finish in the third quarter of 2029, with seven stops.
properties.description: The Gdańsk Południe–Wrzeszcz route will connect the southern districts to the established Wrzeszcz tram and rail interchange through a new tunnel and seven stops.

Preferred construction offer selected in April 2026

properties.name: Wrocław Tram to Jagodno
properties.timeline: The bus-and-tram corridor to Jagodno is being designed for delivery around 2029, including a grade-separated crossing at Bardzka.
properties.description: Wrocław is converting the Jagodno transport corridor into a bus-and-tram route, extending electric tram service south from the existing network toward Jagodno P+R.
milestones: Railway grade separation agreed in March 2026
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Gaj–Bardzka–Jagodno corridor; final tram track and stop geometry remains in design.

properties.name: Toulouse Metro Line C
properties.timeline: The 27 km, 21-station third metro line from Colomiers to Labège is under construction, with passenger service planned for 2028.
properties.description: Toulouse’s Line C will cross the metropolitan area from Colomiers through central Toulouse to Labège, linking five municipalities and four park-and-ride sites.
milestones: Tunnel and viaduct works active in 2026
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Colomiers–Toulouse–Labège corridor; station and tunnel geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Bergen Light Rail to Åsane
properties.timeline: The planned extension from Bergen city centre to Åsane is in route and regulatory planning, including a revised tunnel solution through the city centre and Sandviken.
properties.description: Bergen’s fifth light-rail stage will extend Bybanen north from the city centre to Åsane, with planning also coordinating the main cycling route and Fløyfjell Tunnel works.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Bergen–Sandviken–Åsane corridor; the central tunnel and station alignment remains subject to regulatory planning.

properties.name: Rail Baltica Riga Node
properties.agency: Eiropas Dzelzceļa līnijas / RB Rail AS
properties.timeline: The Rail Baltica Riga node includes the southern section of Riga Central Station and connecting mainline works, with construction and systems integration continuing in 2026.
properties.description: Rail Baltica is building a new standard-gauge passenger-rail connection through Riga, including the rebuilt central station and links toward the airport and the southern mainline.
milestones: Southern Riga Central Station section in construction
Permanent power and systems testing began in 2026
Latvian mainline construction active south of Riga
